title: Learning-Based Interpolation of Detector Gaps in Photon-Counting X-ray Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2611.15614v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Image detectors assembled from tiled modules have physical gaps in the field of view that must be filled before downstream processing such as phase retrieval or tomographic reconstruction. Unlike natural-image inpainting, detector-gap interpolation must leave all other pixels unmodified and preserve the intensity statistics of the filled region, since even a small shift in mean intensity can cause ring artifacts after reconstruction. We adapted two generative models, a Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty (WGAN-GP) and a conditional Pix2Pix model, to this task. We implemented a masking strategy that restricts all changes to the gap pixels and loss terms that constrain the mean intensity and the intensity distribution of the filled region. Both models were trained on nanoCT projections with simulated gaps and compared with linear interpolation, Navier--Stokes inpainting, and the deep image-inpainting network MADF, quantitatively on sim

translated_title: 光子计数X射线成像中探测器间隙的基于学习的插值
translated_abstract: 由拼接模块组装而成的图像探测器在视场中存在物理间隙，在进行相位恢复或断层重建等下游处理之前必须将其填补。与自然图像修复不同，探测器间隙插值必须保持所有其他像素不变，并保留填充区域的强度统计特性，因为即使平均强度的微小偏移也可能在重建后导致环形伪影。我们将两种生成模型——带梯度惩罚的Wasserstein GAN（WGAN-GP）和条件Pix2Pix模型——应用于此任务。我们实现了一种掩蔽策略，将所有变化限制在间隙像素内，并引入了约束填充区域平均强度和强度分布的损失项。两个模型均在带有模拟间隙的nanoCT投影上训练，并与线性插值、Navier-Stokes修复以及深度图像修复网络MADF进行了定量比较。
tldr: 该论文将WGAN-GP和条件Pix2Pix两种生成模型通过掩蔽策略和强度统计约束适配于光子计数X射线成像的探测器间隙插值任务，在仅修改间隙像素的同时保持填充区域的强度统计特性，性能优于传统插值和深度修复方法。
en_tdlr: This paper adapts WGAN-GP and conditional Pix2Pix generative models with a masking strategy and intensity-statistics constraints for detector-gap interpolation in photon-counting X-ray imaging, modifying only gap pixels while preserving the filled region's intensity statistics and outperforming linear interpolation, Navier-Stokes inpainting, and MADF.
